description: Experimental visual scan of a selected 4–60 second range. For longer videos defaults to the first 60 seconds; use fromSeconds and durationSeconds to scan another section. Suggests similar two-second ranges for manual review, separating low-motion matches. Timestamps are relative to the original video. May miss crops, edits and repeats, and can flag intentional or similar footage. Audio and intent are not checked; an empty result does not approve the video.
name: scan_repeated_shots
title: Suggest possible repeated shots (experimental)
